For more information and to order stereo imagery products, please refer to the GEO Stereo Imagery Order Form.

  • Time of Capture: May 7th - May 19th, 2017
  • Number of Images: 226 lines 
  • Resolution: 18 centimetre (RGBN)
  • Bit-depth: 16-bit 
  • Number of bands: Four band (RGBN) 
  • Format: TIFF (SocetSet model setup) 
  • Camera(s): Leica ADS100 line based 
The acquisition area spans two Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) Zones of UTM Zone 15 and UTM Zone 16.  View the acquisition area for each zone by clicking the links near the bottom of this record.  A new page opens and you may need to zoom in to see the individual one kilometre squared tiles.  To download the index, click the ‘View Full Details’ button and finally the ‘Download’ button near the top of the page that opens. Alternatively, you can click HERE to bring the map up in an ArcGIS online map viewer. 

 

For more information on the North Western Ontario Orthophotography Project (NWOOP) 2017 please see the main NWOOP 2017 GeoHub record. 

 
Available Products: 
Stereo Frames 
  • North Western Ontario Orthophotography Project (NWOOP) 2017 - Stereo Lines and associated Models 

Contact Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources - Geospatial Ontario, imagery@ontario.ca
